items.title: Dow Giant Walmart Sinks To A 2026 Low Despite Earnings Beat-And-Raise
items.summary: Walmart raised guidance for the full year early Thursday after beating earnings and revenue estimates for its second quarter. But WMT stock plunged to a multi-month low. Walmart is the world's largest retailer by 2025 sales, according to the National Retail Federation.

items.title: 2 Reasons to Like COST (and 1 Not So Much)
items.summary: Costco has been treading water for the past six months, recording a small loss of 2.7% while holding steady at $958.95. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 11.3% gain during that period.

items.title: Walmart Drops 8% on Slowest Same-Store Sales Growth Since 2020; Target Holds Steady, Costco Eases
items.summary: Walmart's stock cratered Thursday morning while Target and Costco barely flinched, and the gap between those reactions reveals something important about where retail's real pressure points actually sit.

items.title: Costco Is Quietly Building Its Next Big Growth Engine
items.summary: Costco's membership flywheel and Kirkland brand get all the attention, but a quieter stack of retail media, AI search, and pharmacy is scaling fast enough to change how investors should value the stock.

items.title: Costco (COST) Enters The Medicare Insurance Market
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) has entered the Medicare insurance market through a new partnership with SCAN Group to offer Costco branded Medicare Advantage and supplement plans. The move marks Costco's first significant step into healthcare insurance, targeting its senior membership base with dedicated coverage options.
